measurement_process.funding_boundary_mode_reference: bound by reference to the exact value already registered for CANDIDATE_BREADTH_V2_CSMOM_24/72/168/336 in experiments/research/candidates.jsonl; not invented for this experiment. CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM is Breadth V2 Tier A (OHLCV-only decision input, per experiments/specs/breadth_v2_preregistration.md Section 5), but the frozen PortfolioKernel still charges/pays realized funding settlements for any open perpetual position regardless of tier, per Section 6/7; missing funding fails closed.

old_proposition_excluded: CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM has validated excess return or alpha (it does not; Breadth V2 final_frozen_family_status=FAIL).
new_proposition: The fixed CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM measurement process's daily MEASUREMENT_STRATEGY_UTILITY relative to FLAT may vary by point-in-time CROSS_SECTIONAL_DISPERSION.

variant_treatment.reason: All four already-registered CSMOM lookback coordinates (24/72/168/336h) are preserved and assessed under one predeclared, count-based consistency criterion; no coordinate is added, dropped, averaged into a new ensemble, or selected for being best.
variant_treatment.family_consistency_rule: At least 3 of 4 registered variants must show a directionally consistent (negative) STRESS HIGH_MINUS_LOW_MEAN_UTILITY contrast for the piece to be a candidate; consistent_count/4 reported regardless of outcome. This is the exact rule computed by qntylab.jigsaw_cross_sectional_dispersion_v0.family_consistency().
variant_treatment.claim_scope_if_family_consistent: CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM family, DEV_2024, frozen 20-asset Breadth V2 panel -- not a claim about any single lookback being best.
prohibited: averaging lookbacks into a new ensemble

primary_family_statistic.definition: consistent_count: the count, out of the 4 registered CSMOM lookback variants, whose STRESS HIGH_MINUS_LOW_MEAN_UTILITY contrast has the preregistered negative sign.
primary_family_statistic.computation_reference: qntylab.jigsaw_cross_sectional_dispersion_v0.family_consistency(); no other function computes or may compute a family-level number for this experiment
primary_family_statistic.per_variant_reporting: each variant's HIGH_MINUS_LOW_MEAN_UTILITY magnitude is reported individually and descriptively alongside consistent_count; magnitudes are never averaged, weighted, or otherwise combined into a scalar economic aggregate
primary_family_statistic.no_pooled_scalar: there is no 'pooled family-first HIGH_MINUS_LOW_MEAN_UTILITY' value anywhere in this experiment; any prior draft language implying one was in error and is corrected by this field. No existing frozen QntyLab authority requires a cross-variant economic average for a measurement-only Jigsaw piece, so none is introduced (minimum-authority solution).

dispersion_recipe.cross_sectional_universe: Exact frozen Breadth V2 20-asset panel (FROZEN_PANEL_ORDER); no other universe claim.
dispersion_recipe.asset_eligibility_at_t: All 20 panel members must have a valid close at t and at t-24h; missing any one blocks the whole daily observation (mirrors CSMOM's own whole-panel missingness rule; no partial-panel computation).
dispersion_recipe.return_definition: simple return, close(t)/close(t-24h) - 1, per panel asset
dispersion_recipe.dispersion_statistic: cross-sectional sample standard deviation, ddof=1, of the 20 per-asset 24h returns at t
dispersion_recipe.known_at_semantics: computed strictly from close(t) and close(t-24h); no bar at or after the decision timestamp is used
dispersion_recipe.missing_member_semantics: fail-closed; whole daily observation blocked if any of the 20 panel members is missing or non-finite
dispersion_recipe.normalization: 365-day trailing inclusive empirical CDF percentile, reused byte-identically from qntylab.jigsaw_trend_condition_dependence_v0.historical_percentile
dispersion_recipe.binning: LOW <= 33.333p, MID, HIGH >= 66.667p; reused byte-identically from qntylab.jigsaw_trend_condition_dependence_v0.state_bin
dispersion_recipe.ties: inclusive empirical CDF, count(values <= current)/count(values); identical convention to the reused normalization module
dispersion_recipe.source_identity: Frozen Binance USD-M 1h OHLCV panel under the same input contract already qualified for Breadth V2 (BREADTH_V2_INPUT_BUNDLE_V0 price contract)
rejected_alternatives_recorded_not_teste: interquartile range of cross-sectional returns (rejected: adds a quantile-selection degree of freedom beyond what literature or existing conventions require)
mean absolute deviation (rejected: stdev is the more literature-anchored and QntyLab-convention-compatible statistic; MAD adds no PIT or mechanistic advantage here)

dispersion horizon tied to each CSMOM variant's own lookback, i.e. 4 different dispersion recipes (rejected: violates the single-frozen-recipe requirement and would confound 'is dispersion predictive' with 'does dispersion horizon match strategy horizon')
value-weighted or liquidity-weighted dispersion (rejected: no liquidity/market-cap contract is frozen for this panel; would silently invent a new weighting assumption)

universe.note: Results describe the frozen Breadth V2 20-asset source-conditioned panel only; no claim about the Binance perpetual universe or the broader cryptocurrency market is made.

development_sample.reason_only_dev_2024_is_usable: CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM's own Breadth V2 development execution shows 0/8 usable cells in DEV_2022 and 0/8 usable cells in DEV_2025 (whole-panel missing-member blocking), versus 8/8 usable in DEV_2024 (4 variants x 2 cost modes). This experiment's economic sample cannot exceed where the fixed measurement process itself produced usable observations, so it is bound to DEV_2024. This is a discovered constraint, verified from experiments/research/breadth_v2_receipts/*.json, not a choice made to reach a preferred sample.
development_sample.warmup: Observations strictly before DEV_2024 may be used only to construct the 365-day trailing dispersion percentile normalization; they are never labelled as economic decisions. Warm-up requires only OHLCV (no funding is needed to compute a non-economic percentile seed). Warm-up panel completeness back to ~2023-01-01 must be verified before execution; if incomplete, the affected early-2024 decisions are blocked (see BLOCKED_BY_PIT_INPUT_SEMANTICS) rather than computed with a partial trailing history.
development_sample.sealed_t0_exclusion: No observation at or after 2026-08-10T19:00:00Z (SEALED_T0) is used; DEV_2024 ends 2024-12-31T23:00:00Z, well before SEALED_T0, so no proximity risk exists.

decision_grid.compatibility_note: CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM's native cadence is hourly (target recomputed and portfolio rebalanced bar t -> t+1, per the frozen Breadth V2 execution contract). Rather than inventing a new daily signal, this experiment re-bins the already-realized hourly net-of-cost equity path emitted by the frozen, unmodified CSMOM target-weight process into non-overlapping 24h blocks starting 00:00 UTC, using geometric compounding of the hourly net-of-cost equity ratio within each block (equity(t+24h)/equity(t) - 1), consistent with the existing qntylab.jigsaw_trend_condition_dependence_v0._utility prod(1+r)-1 convention -- not additive summation of hourly returns, which would understate compounding effects and be inconsistent with the already-frozen Jigsaw utility definition. The target-weight computation itself is untouched; only the post-hoc aggregation window and compounding convention for the conditioning statistic are specified. This is the justified, pre-execution-frozen alternative required when native family semantics do not match the daily Jigsaw convention. This fix was the subject of the CRITICAL finding in hostile_review.md and was re-verified in targeted_re_review.md.

label: MEASUREMENT_STRATEGY_UTILITY

cost_contract.primary_cost_mode_authority: Determined only from existing frozen authority, never from desired or observed results: (1) Breadth V2 family-level advancement rule (experiments/specs/breadth_v2_preregistration.md Section 8, items 2 and 4) gates on 'stressed benchmark excess' / 'stressed net-return advantage', i.e. STRESS is the binding cost mode. (2) The prior Jigsaw piece (qntylab.jigsaw_trend_condition_dependence_v0.analyze) anchors its eligibility test on `stress = primary[state]["STRESS"][...]` and requires BASELINE to merely agree in sign with STRESS (same_sign(baseline)), not the reverse. Both existing authorities treat STRESS as primary and BASELINE as the secondary/consistency check; this experiment follows the same convention.
cost_contract.secondary_cost_mode: BASELINE_EXECUTION, used only to check that the STRESS-based consistent_count verdict is not an artifact of stress costs (see robustness_contract.cost_robustness); never used to compute the primary family statistic.
cost_contract.funding: Realized Binance USD-M funding settlements per the existing Breadth V2 Section 7 contract, referenced not reinvented; missing funding fails closed per the existing rule.
cost_contract.note: No new or favorable cost mode is introduced; identical to Breadth V2 Section 7.

primary_hypothesis.statement: Higher point-in-time cross-sectional dispersion (24h trailing, 20-asset frozen panel, sample stdev ddof=1) predicts weaker subsequent daily MEASUREMENT_STRATEGY_UTILITY of the frozen CROSS_SECTIONAL_MOMENTUM family relative to FLAT, over the following non-overlapping 24h block, within DEV_2024, assessed via the primary_family_statistic (consistent_count, threshold >=3 of 4 registered lookback variants) under the primary STRESS cost mode.
primary_hypothesis.predicted_sign: signed HIGH_MINUS_LOW_MEAN_UTILITY < 0 under STRESS cost, for at least 3 of 4 registered variants (consistent_count >= 3)
primary_hypothesis.literature_seed_only_not_evidence: Zhang & Makgolo (2026, SSRN 6648082) report that higher cross-sectional return dispersion coincides with weaker subsequent cross-sectional momentum in cryptocurrency markets; this motivates direction only and is not treated as QntyLab evidence.

state_normalization.tie_handling: inclusive empirical CDF: count(values <= current) / count(values), trailing only
state_normalization.binding: by implementation identity import, not reimplementation; proven in tests/test_jigsaw_cross_sectional_dispersion_v0.py

multiplicity.primary_comparison: primary_family_statistic (consistent_count) under the primary STRESS cost mode across the 4 registered CSMOM lookback variants, 3-of-4 directional-consistency threshold; no scalar pooled/averaged contrast exists anywhere in this experiment
secondary_or_descriptive_only: per-variant HIGH_MINUS_LOW_MEAN_UTILITY (4 variants; descriptive, feeds only the frozen consistency count, never a best-variant claim)
BASELINE cost mode (secondary; used only as the cost-robustness check against the STRESS-based primary verdict, per cost_contract.secondary_cost_mode)
H1_2024 / H2_2024 calendar-half consistent_count (temporal-stability substitute, weaker evidence, explicitly labelled)
descriptive correlation of CROSS_SECTIONAL_DISPERSION against MARKET_DRAWDOWN_30D / MARKET_RV_7D / MARKET_CORR_7D on the same panel path

robustness_contract.temporal_stability: BLOCKED_AT_CROSS_WINDOW_LEVEL: only DEV_2024 has usable CSMOM cells (inherited Breadth V2 constraint, not invented here). Substitute: recompute consistent_count separately within H1_2024 and H2_2024 under STRESS; both halves must independently meet consistent_count >= 3 of 4 for temporal robustness to hold. Frozen before outcomes, explicitly labelled weaker than genuine multi-year replication.
robustness_contract.cost_robustness: Recompute consistent_count under BASELINE using the identical per-variant sign rule; the STRESS-based primary verdict is cost-robust only if the BASELINE consistent_count is also >= 3 of 4. There is no pooled scalar to compare signs of; the comparison is count-to-count, one cost mode at a time.
robustness_contract.cross_sectional_concentration_attack: leave-one-asset-out across all 20 panel members, recomputing both dispersion and the CSMOM ranking with that asset excluded, then recomputing consistent_count under STRESS; no single asset may be required for the family-consistent (>=3 of 4) verdict.
robustness_contract.variant_consistency_family_first: the 3-of-4 directional consistency rule (primary_family_statistic) itself is the primary test; also report consistent_count/4 verbatim alongside each variant's individual magnitude.
robustness_contract.tail_concentration: five-best/five-worst daily-observation removal under STRESS, reusing the prior Jigsaw convention, then recompute consistent_count on the trimmed sample.
robustness_contract.missingness_breadth_dependence: Because eligibility requires the full 20/20 panel by construction, breadth is constant (20/20) at every included decision; this check degenerates to an integrity assertion (zero partial-panel contamination) rather than a graded diagnostic, and is reported as such.
robustness_contract.point_in_time_leakage: dispersion computed only from close(t) and close(t-24h); normalization percentile uses only trailing values through t; proven by synthetic tests.
robustness_contract.state_distinctness_redundancy: descriptive-only Pearson/Spearman correlation of CROSS_SECTIONAL_DISPERSION against the three existing Jigsaw states (MARKET_DRAWDOWN_30D, MARKET_RV_7D, MARKET_CORR_7D) computed on the same panel path; DISPERSION_STATE_NOT_DISTINCT_ENOUGH_TO_JUSTIFY_NEW_PIECE if |correlation| >= 0.90 with any one of them.
robustness_contract.dependence_aware_uncertainty: moving block bootstrap, 7 calendar-day blocks, 1000 resamples, fixed seed 271828; identical convention to the prior Jigsaw piece.

kill_defer_criteria.CONDITION_DEPENDENCE_VARIANT_CONCENTRATE: identical trigger to NO_CONDITION_DEPENDENCE_FOUND (STRESS consistent_count < 3 of 4); named separately only to label the failure mode as variant concentration when reporting, since there is a single primary_family_statistic and no separate family-wide aggregate to fail independently
kill_defer_criteria.CONDITION_DEPENDENCE_TEMPORALLY_UNSTABLE: H1_2024 consistent_count < 3 of 4 or H2_2024 consistent_count < 3 of 4 under STRESS
kill_defer_criteria.CONDITION_DEPENDENCE_COST_FRAGILE: STRESS consistent_count >= 3 of 4 but BASELINE consistent_count < 3 of 4 (the verdict does not replicate under the secondary cost mode)
kill_defer_criteria.CONDITION_DEPENDENCE_TAIL_CONCENTRATED: five-best/five-worst removal causes STRESS consistent_count to drop below 3 of 4
kill_defer_criteria.CONDITION_DEPENDENCE_BREADTH_OR_MISSINGN: any partial-panel (< 20/20) observation is found to have contributed to the result (integrity failure)
kill_defer_criteria.DISPERSION_STATE_NOT_DISTINCT_ENOUGH_TO_: abs(correlation) >= 0.90 with MARKET_DRAWDOWN_30D, MARKET_RV_7D, or MARKET_CORR_7D
kill_defer_criteria.BLOCKED_BY_PIT_INPUT_SEMANTICS: warm-up panel completeness insufficient for the 365-day trailing normalization, or any gap-fill/forward-fill is required to compute an observation
kill_defer_criteria.BLOCKED_BY_MEASUREMENT_PROCESS_IDENTITY: the CSMOM target-weight computation or panel used at execution time does not byte-identically match qntylab.breadth_v2_strategies.cross_sectional_weights / qntylab.breadth_v2_runner.FROZEN_PANEL_ORDER, the funding_boundary_mode used does not byte-identically match REALIZED_FUNDING_SETTLEMENTS_REQUIRED as registered for CANDIDATE_BREADTH_V2_CSMOM_*, or this module's contract_digest() does not match the frozen value recorded at freeze time
